name: Splunk - Intrusion Detection Queries (Sysmon + Windows Events)
command: index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 (Image="*cmd.exe" OR Image="*powershell.exe") | stats count by ParentImage, Image
description: SPL queries for real-world intrusion detection using Sysmon and Windows Security events. Covers suspicious parent-child process chains, DCSync detection, LSASS credential dumping, and CallTrace UNKNOWN shellcode detection with progressive false-positive filtering.
source: CDSA Module 05: Understanding Log Sources & Investigating with Splunk
notes:
=== Parent-Child Process Chain Analysis (Event 1) ===
  # All parent-child trees:
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | stats count by ParentImage, Image

  # Narrow to suspicious children (cmd.exe / powershell.exe):
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 (Image="*cmd.exe" OR Image="*powershell.exe") | stats count by ParentImage, Image

  # Drill into specific suspicious parent (e.g. notepad.exe → powershell.exe):
  index="main" sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 (Image="*cmd.exe" OR Image="*powershell.exe") ParentImage="C:\\Windows\\System32\\notepad.exe"
  → Suspicious finding: notepad.exe spawning PowerShell to download files

=== Investigate a Suspicious IP Across All Sources ===
  # What sourcetypes mention this IP?
  index="main" 10.0.0.229 | stats count by sourcetype

  # Linux syslog — confirm IP belongs to which host:
  index="main" 10.0.0.229 sourcetype="linux:syslog"

  # What commands ran involving this IP (Sysmon)?
  index="main" 10.0.0.229 sourcetype="WinEventLog:sysmon" | stats count by CommandLine

  # Which hosts ran those commands?
  index="main" 10.0.0.229 sourcetype="WinEventLog:sysmon" | stats count by CommandLine, host

=== DCSync Attack Detection (Event 4662) ===
  index="main" EventCode=4662 Access_Mask=0x100 Account_Name!=*$
  → Event 4662: AD object accessed
  → Access_Mask 0x100: Control Access (required for DCSync)
  → Account_Name!=*$: filter out machine accounts (DCSync should only be done by machines)
  → Expand Properties field: look for GUIDs:
      {1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2} = DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All
      {19195a5b-6da0-11d0-afd3-00c04fd930c9} = DS-Replication-Get-Changes

=== LSASS Credential Dump Detection (Event 10) ===
  # All processes opening handles to lsass — sorted by frequency:
  index="main" EventCode=10 lsass | stats count by SourceImage

  # Investigate specific suspicious source (e.g. notepad):
  index="main" EventCode=10 lsass SourceImage="C:\\Windows\\System32\\notepad.exe"
  → GrantedAccess 0x1FFFFF = PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS (highly suspicious)
  → CallTrace with UNKNOWN = shellcode/unbacked memory region

=== CallTrace UNKNOWN — Shellcode Detection (iterative refinement) ===
Goal: detect processes making API calls from unbacked memory (shellcode indicator)

  # Step 1: see which event codes have UNKNOWN call traces:
  index="main" CallTrace="*UNKNOWN*" | stats count by EventCode
  → Typically only EventCode 10 (ProcessAccess)

  # Step 2: group by source process:
  index="main" CallTrace="*UNKNOWN*" | stats count by SourceImage

  # Step 3: filter self-accesses (process != process):
  index="main" CallTrace="*UNKNOWN*" | where SourceImage!=TargetImage | stats count by SourceImage

  # Step 4: exclude .NET JIT false positives (clr.dll, ni.dll, Microsoft.NET path):
  index="main" CallTrace="*UNKNOWN*" SourceImage!="*Microsoft.NET*" CallTrace!=*ni.dll* CallTrace!=*clr.dll* | where SourceImage!=TargetImage | stats count by SourceImage

  # Step 5: exclude WOW64 (Heaven's Gate — unbacked by design):
  index="main" CallTrace="*UNKNOWN*" SourceImage!="*Microsoft.NET*" CallTrace!=*ni.dll* CallTrace!=*clr.dll* CallTrace!=*wow64* | where SourceImage!=TargetImage | stats count by SourceImage

  # Step 6: exclude Explorer.exe (too broad, high false-positive rate):
  index="main" CallTrace="*UNKNOWN*" SourceImage!="*Microsoft.NET*" CallTrace!=*ni.dll* CallTrace!=*clr.dll* CallTrace!=*wow64* SourceImage!="C:\\Windows\\Explorer.EXE" | where SourceImage!=TargetImage | stats count by SourceImage

  # Step 7: final alert query — add TargetImage and CallTrace for triage:
  index="main" CallTrace="*UNKNOWN*" SourceImage!="*Microsoft.NET*" CallTrace!=*ni.dll* CallTrace!=*clr.dll* CallTrace!=*wow64* SourceImage!="C:\\Windows\\Explorer.EXE" | where SourceImage!=TargetImage | stats count by SourceImage, TargetImage, CallTrace

Known false positives to filter:
  → Squirrel.exe / electron apps (Chromium JIT)
  → Any process with ni.dll (NGen compiled .NET) in call trace
  → WOW64 transitions (32-bit process on 64-bit OS)
  → Explorer.exe (loads arbitrary extensions)
